signal: Centrical raised a $39M Series D in June 2026 led by Leeds Illuminate to expand its Performance Intelligence OS and AI tools for managing both human and digital workers.

email.body1:
Zac, saw Centrical just closed a $39M Series D to expand your Performance Intelligence OS.

Scaling that fast usually means more in-market accounts than a business development team can cover before momentum cools, and that is where deals slip. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Centrical off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Zac, quick follow-up for Centrical.

Post-Series-D, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Centrical needs to close that gap, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Zac, last bit of proof for Centrical.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Centrical's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise SaaS teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Zac, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority this quarter, no problem at all. The stretch from raise to expansion is its own kind of busy, and I know timing matters.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your business development motion? I'll tailor it to Centrical either way.
